headline: Live transfer rumors, news, updates on deadline day
description: We bring you the latest news, rumors, done deals and reaction throughout Europe's transfer deadline day, up to the Premier League window closing at 6 p.m. ET.

headline: Arsenal's Ethan Nwaneri close to Borussia Dortmund loan - sources
description: Arsenal midfielder Ethan Nwaneri is heading to Borussia Dortmund on loan, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Arsenal's Mikel Arteta downplays Cristhian Mosquera injury concerns
description: Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta says Cristhian Mosquera is "fine" and was taken off as a precaution during Monday night's 1-0 win at Aston Villa after the Spanish defender reported feeling pain.

headline: Yoane Wissa's Newcastle sequel is already looking better than the original
description: Two matches into the 26-27 season, and Newcastle United's Yoane Wissa has already matched his Premier League goal tally for the entirety of last term.

headline: Africa's transfer deadline day - Ndiaye to Man City, Mbaye incoming, Osimhen to Man United?
description: Tuesday is the final day of the window, but which African players could get their move over the line before business concludes on Sept. 1?

headline: Arsenal remain undefeated in the Premier League
description: The defending champions sneak past Aston Villa 1-0, thanks to a 59th-minute goal from Bukayo Saka.
